Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Lord Krishna explains how He reciprocates with all living entities based on how they approach Him, emphasizing that everyone ultimately follows His path in various ways.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Understanding how the Divine interacts with individuals holding different desires, intentions, and levels of awareness.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'ye yatha mam prapadyante tams tathaiva bhajamy aham, mama vartmanuvartante manusyah partha sarvasah' (As people surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly; everyone follows My path in all respects).
Outcome/Resolution: Provides clarity that divine reciprocation is perfectly tailored to individual intention, fostering inclusivity and personal responsibility.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Tailored Reciprocation: Receiving outcomes aligned with the specific effort and intention invested
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Personal Responsibility in Relationships: Understanding that one's internal posture dictates emotional returns
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Universal Inclusion: Recognizing that every individual is on a meaningful developmental path

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Ye yatha mam prapadyante tams tathaiva bhajamy aham (As they surrender to Me, I reward them accordingly)
Mama vartmanuvartante (Everyone follows My path in all respects)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Krishna reciprocates with every soul according to their degree of surrender and desire, confirming that all spiritual paths ultimately seek and connect to Him.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Outcomes reflect the quality of intention and effort invested; recognizing this dynamic empowers individuals to take responsibility for their mental and emotional reality.
